Canvas fits 4 per box. Paper print fits 6 per box.

1 canvas in box -> box is 25% filled
1 paper print is 1/6 of box -> ~17% filled

(1/4)*3 + (1/6)*2 = 1.08 -> over box limit

(1/4)*3 + (1/6) = 0.92 -> under box limit

3 canvas and 1 paper prints fit in one large box, leaving 3 paper print left. Add extra to one large box -> 2 large boxes
